newsitem.title: USA: Temple-Inland, Caraustar to build new plant.
newsitem.headline: Temple-Inland, Caraustar to build new plant.

text.p: Temple-Inland Forest Products Corp, a unit of Temple-Inland Inc, said Thursday that it and Caraustar Industries Inc plan to construct and operate a gypsum wallboard plant in the Clarksville, Tennessee area with an annual capacity of about 700 million square feet of gypsum wallboard.
The plant will operate under the Standard Gypsum LLC joint venture, of which Temple-Inland and Caraustar are equal partners and employ 120 workers.
The company did not disclose the cost of the project.
Temple-Inland said it will manage plant operations for the joint venture and market the product through its existing sales network, while Caraustar provides wallboard facing paper for the product.

Caraustar is a producer of recycled paperboard and converted paperboard products. Temple-Inland Inc is a holding company with major interests in paper, packaging, building materials and financial services.
